commits.message:
fix(host): App takes a Theme, so its frames resolve the names it adds (rich-host-qvji) (#284)

* fix(host): App takes a Theme, so its frames resolve the names it adds (rich-host-qvji)

AppOptions had no theme, so the Console App builds always fell back to the
built-in names: a user's theme name drew plain in a RichText and threw from
getStyle under App and WidgetApp.

* fix(host): App takes the console's drawing options as the console declares them (rich-host-qvji)

AppOptions picked asciiOnly and theme from ConsoleOptions by hand, one field
at a time; onStyleError, markup, highlight and highlighter never reached a
frame. It now extends a Pick of ConsoleOptions and forwards by spread.

Review (high): tests no longer pass on a missing segment; WidgetApp's frames
are covered; docs separate the style-name Theme from a widget's palette.

* fix(host): App copies only the drawing options it names to its console (rich-host-qvji)

A rest spread passed any extra property of the options object — width,
getSize, colorSystem, file — to the console, overriding what the host
decides. One key list is now both the type and what is copied.
